result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there is a visual defect in the top-right corner: a circular button (likely profile/avatar) appears as an empty gray placeholder with only a small red notification dot, missing its expected icon or avatar content. The partially visible carousel item on the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behaviors and not counted as defects.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right header renders as a blank gray circle with only a small red notification dot; no avatar image, icon, or label is visible, making its purpose unclear and looking like a failed/placeholder asset.
issues.suggestion: Populate the button with the intended content (user avatar or a recognizable icon such as a profile/bell glyph). If the image failed to load, add a fallback icon and ensure the asset loads correctly.

issues.description: The top-right circular button has no visible text or icon, so it lacks an accessible name and its function (profile, notifications, etc.) cannot be determined visually or by assistive technology.
issues.suggestion: Add a meaningful icon plus an accessibility label (e.g., aria-label="Profile" or "Notifications") so the control is identifiable and operable.
